comments.text: VIC patterns $00-$7F, eight scanline bytes per character. The train field uses these for train roofs, doors, clouds and trackside scenery. The VIC sees bank 0 and charset offset $2800 on the playfield.
Patterns $80-$FF for the train charset at $2800. The high-index patterns are selected by map bytes in the same way as the lower 128.
Train tile IDs from row 0, column 0 through row 3, column 255 (zero-based, 256 bytes per row). The viewport renderer at $883C reads these through the row pointers at $3400/$3500.
